explanation: The top disk contributes integrand x. For the lower hemisphere h=-√(9-x²-y²), the outward vector area element is ⟨h_x,h_y,-1⟩ dA, so its flux integrand is x/√(9-x²-y²)-x. Adding gives option e. Other displayed expressions also integrate to zero by symmetry over D, but e is the expression obtained directly from the surface flux calculation.
